name: srvname-full-permit-wrong-domain-invalid
description: RFC 4985 §4: a permittedSubtrees SRVName constraint of _mail.example.com does NOT match an SRVName SAN of _mail.example.net because the DNS part differs. With the NC marked critical and the SRVName form present in the SAN, a conforming RFC 4985 validator rejects; an RFC 5280-only validator that does not understand SRVName must still reject (critical NC on a present name form).
